visualCharacteristics.layout: Pill toggles above a bordered diagram frame with expand control and PDF link
visualCharacteristics.notes: Block diagram switcher: 5 pill toggles (S32K3 Single-Core, S32K3 Dual/Lockstep Features, S32K3 for ASIL D Features, S32K3 for Multicore, S32K3 Software Ecosystem); each panel shows a titled diagram image in a bordered frame with expand icon and a "Get Diagram PDF" button.

contentPattern.structure: one row per diagram: label | H3 title, diagram image, Get Diagram PDF link

reuseGuidance: Use for switching between alternate diagrams/images; use tabs for general tabbed content.
